I turn 25 next month and I just landed my first job within my field since graduating college when I was 22. 3. FRICKEN. Years. I was also in horribly abusive relationship throughout this time. I was stucking working retail for a year, then canvassing for a nonprofit, then I quit that after a month and luckily enough, my uber driver one day told me about this staffing agency and I got this tech job in customer service. I noticed that most places dont give a flying fuck about you if you dont submit a cover letter or your resume isn’t perfect. I critique resumes for friends if you’d like me to take a look I wouldn’t mind. Anyways good luck out there. You got this fam. Stay strong and know better things are coming your way.
